title: flt.c_notch
description: `flt.c_notch` calculates biquad coefficients for a notch (reject) filter and outputs them as the list `b0 b1 b2 a1 a2`. Its center frequency is set in Hz (20–22050), while `@rad` enables angular-frequency input; the quality factor is defined as frequency divided by bandwidth, and bandwidth can also be set in octaves with `bw`.
